g.text: Get better at multi-step arithmetic word problems without getting worse at anything else.
Tom buys 7 boxes of pencils. Each box has 6 pencils. He gives away 6 pencils. How many pencils does he have left?
Tom buys 7 boxes with 6 pencils each, so he has 7 * 6 = 42 pencils.
